title: Real Research Today: Canal Freight Revivals
definition: Today's documented research behind Canal Freight Revivals.

Stratospheric balloons and airships (Sceye, Flying Whales) return as cargo platforms. Together these programs form the electric barges foundation that Canal Freight Revivals will build on — the revival logistics results, the lock automation methods, and the institutional memory.

title: Readiness Estimator: Canal Freight Revivals
definition: Estimates Canal Freight Revivals readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Canal Freight Revivals components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a revival hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Canal Freight Revivals Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Canal Freight Revivals: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Canal Freight Revivals — revivals of canal freight.

Phase 1 — Prove (electric barges): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (revival logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (lock automation): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (last-mile): revival hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and regions-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
